name: sauron-recon-hourly-search-pdf-preview
prompt: Load the confirmed Sauron Recon criteria from the local runtime store. Read the knowledge context pack. Run the deterministic search, preserve per-source failures, persist idempotently, select only new or changed listings since the last successful run, render a deduplicated PDF with public descriptions and links, and report coverage. Do not send externally, do not mark disappearances unless a source explicitly declares a complete snapshot, and do not treat empty/partial responses as empty inventories.
